_comment: Every document that has ever touched any of our own training sets (rec v6-v13, layout, V3), by document id and content sha256. The test split is built from documents NOT in this list; check_training_exclusion() turns that claim into a failing build. TO BE POPULATED by the benchmark authors from the training-set inventories before the first freeze - an empty list here is a statement that nothing has been inventoried yet, not that nothing overlaps.
